spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace membership and the seller entitlement remain backend-enforced.
The last recorded ask is evidence from SpellBook and is not a current remote marketplace observation unless remoteObservationAtIso is populated.
A projected value is a fresh projection from saved evidence and never proves a marketplace listing is live.
A null decision means no customer-safe evidence exists for that item and channel.

description: Read one seller listing's recorded pricing evidence for one marketplace. Returns the last recorded ask, market anchor, safe price effect, decision timestamps and whether the evidence is observed, recorded, projected or missing. Call this when a seller asks what price was saved or what evidence supports it, then use the seller controls tools when they want to inspect or change a setting. It never claims a remote marketplace ask is current without a remote observation timestamp.

channel.description: Which marketplace listing to explain. Required, because the same copy carries a different ask per channel.

itemId.description: The exact Item id, from a prior spellbook_inventory_items_query. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the listing. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_decision_explain
